/about: Learn it. Build it. Run it.

Cloud4Green Technologies has been building tech skills since 2013. We began by upskilling individuals, grew into corporate training, now run hands-on labs for enterprise teams, and are building ReyvanX, our zero trust product.
From one learner to whole enterprises.
We started in 2013 upskilling individuals, one batch at a time. That grew into corporate training, then into the hands-on labs teams practise on today, and now into ReyvanX.
The idea hasn't changed since the first batch: people learn technology by running it, on real consoles, with real scenarios and a trainer close enough to ask.

2013 Upskilling individuals We started by training individuals: engineers and career-changers learning AWS, Microsoft Azure and VMware in small batches, with live labs and trainers who stayed after class until every doubt was cleared.
Then Corporate training Companies began sending whole teams, so we pushed into corporate training: customised programmes built around each organisation's stack, goals and timelines.
Today Training and labs We deliver both: corporate training programmes, and hands-on cloud and AI labs where teams practise on live environments that look like their own production.

Next ReyvanX Now we're building ReyvanX, our zero trust network access product, which verifies every connection by identity, device and policy while keeping applications invisible to the network. Read about ReyvanX
Four things that have stayed the same from the first classroom batch to the largest enterprise programme.
Live consoles, real scenarios and guard-railed labs. If a skill matters at work, learners practise it before they leave the room.
AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, VMware and the open-source stack around them. We teach what your teams run, not what we resell.
Simple examples first, depth after. Trainers who take the questions, stay after class and explain it again until it lands.
Certifications passed, roles changed, systems shipped. We measure training by what people can do afterwards.
Four products to build skills, and two services to put them to work.
Live cloud and AI lab environments across AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes and more, validated as people work.
Managed enterprise learning: needs analysis, content development, LMS management and ROI reporting.

Cloud4Green Technologies (“Cloud4Green”, “we”, “us”) is a learning and technology company based in Bengaluru, India. We decide how and why the personal data described here is used.
This policy covers cloud4green.com. It does not cover the data handled inside our labs and platforms.
If you use our labs, learning platform or training under an agreement with us or your employer, that agreement and any notice provided with the service apply to the data involved.

Where we provide a service to an organisation, that organisation usually decides how its learners' data is used, and we handle it on the organisation's behalf. If your employer or institution gave you access, please send requests about your data to them first. We will help them respond.

Technical data: your IP address, browser and device type, and the pages requested, as recorded in standard server logs, plus a hashed form of your IP address used to limit repeated form submissions.

reply to your enquiry and prepare quotes or proposals you ask for;
schedule and hold calls with you;
run, secure and fix the website; and
meet our legal obligations and protect our legal rights.
We process it because you provided it for that purpose or consented to it, or where the law otherwise allows. We do not sell your personal data or share it for cross-context behavioural advertising.

Our website hosting provider, which processes technical data to serve the site and relays contact form messages to our inbox.

We keep personal data only for as long as we need it for the purposes above, including any continuing conversation or business relationship with you, or as long as the law requires. We then delete or anonymise it.
